visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long light-brown hair, wearing dark sunglasses, a black sleeveless corset-style vest, and loose brown trousers, dances dynamically on an airport travelator. She holds a branded coffee cup in her right hand. The airport features a distinctive wavy wooden ceiling. The background displays storefronts like THE BODY SHOP and large text PUBLIC. A white text overlay IBIZA is coming is visible at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a second woman with a blue-and-white tie-dye maxi dress and a blue surgical face mask. She is also on a travelator, holding a yellow juice bottle and a black jacket, waving and dancing. Yellow airport gate signs for J43 and J42 are prominent in the background against large glass windows. (3) The view shifts to the first woman in brown pants running away from the camera down a brightly lit, glass-walled airport jet bridge. She wears a black backpack and has both arms raised in the air in a celebratory gesture. The floor is covered with a blue-grey carpet. (4) The first woman is shown again on a travelator, this time performing a rhythmic twerking dance move while holding a small white object. Her back is partially to the camera before she rotates. The travelator has green side panels, and more airport signage is visible in the distance. (5) Both women are seen together on a travelator, smiling and dancing in sync. The woman in the blue dress waves enthusiastically at the lens while the woman in brown continues her energetic movements. The background shows more of the airport terminal's open structure and other travelers. (6) A medium shot captures the woman in brown pants posing and blowing a kiss while walking through the jet bridge. Outside the large glass panels, a commercial airplane with the IBERIA logo on its tail is parked on the tarmac under a clear, bright sky. (7) The woman in brown pants arrives at the aircraft door. She holds a boarding pass and her mobile phone, spinning around excitedly before stepping onto the plane. A crew member or bystander is partially visible in the background inside the terminal gate area. (8) The final scene is a close-up selfie shot of both women laughing joyfully and shouting towards the camera. Their facial expressions convey intense happiness and excitement. Both are wearing sunglasses, and the lighting is very bright, reflecting a vibrant, high-energy travel atmosphere.

The acoustic environment is studio-mastered music with high spectral brightness and minimal audible room tone from the airport, suggesting the music was added in post-production. (2) The musical arrangement continues with high intensity and percussive density. Around the six-second mark, the audio texture changes as high-pitched, energetic female shouting and laughter (vocal arousal level 8) are layered over the music. These vocalizations exhibit significant pitch variability and high intensity, blending with the BGM to create a chaotic but joyful atmosphere of celebration. The recording sounds like a mix of clean digital music and live-captured vocal reactions.
